liveness.means: the Space process answers HTTP; /api/ready checks PostgreSQL and reports degraded dependencies

drains: subscription retries stop; the HTTP server stops accepting requests and gives in-flight requests up to 4 seconds
the PostgreSQL pool closes and the process exits
shutdown.note: server/index.js uses openvibe-sdk/service gracefulStop with a 4-second drain and 5-second deadline

resumes.what: Events subscriptions are recreated and pending network and VIP deliveries are retried idempotently

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy restores the prior sha if /api/ready fails in its readiness window
rollback.window: automatic during deploy readiness; manual afterwards while the previous code is database compatible

blockers.none: Space's own PostgreSQL migrations only create its tables, so an earlier release reads nothing it cannot handle

leases.none: no claims: one Space process runs and owns its database

notes: Space is OpenVibe's code hosting, and "spaces" — apps that use your OpenVibe account and the SDK — come next. The forum returned to OpenVibe.Community (owner decision 2026-10-08), so Space serves a home and its former /s/* forum paths redirect permanently to openvibe.community; it keeps no forum capability, contract or event.
